blocks.text: One export from Google Ads: `search_terms_acme.csv`, the search terms report for July 1, 2026 to July 31, 2026 (31 days), in USD. Nothing in the Google Ads account was changed: this report only reads the export.

items: Waste: search terms with zero conversions and at least $20.00 in cost. Each term's rows are added up first, so a term that converts anywhere in the account is never waste.
Likely bad: the chance a term truly converts at less than half the account's rate, learned from how much this account's own search terms differ. 90% is the bar for adding a negative.
Converting, but expensive: cost per conversion above 3 times the account average.
Worth adding: 2 or more conversions, cost per conversion at or below the account average, and not a keyword yet.
Totals are recomputed from the rows of the export.
A conversion is whatever this account counts as one.
